definitions.explanation: A cat with black fur. In Japan it carries superstitious associations — unlucky in some traditions, but a charm against evil in others.

examples.japanese: {黒猫|くろねこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}った→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧。
examples.english: A black cat crossed the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜道|よみち}→夜道：17541_yomichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{黒猫|くろねこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、なんとなくどきっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Running into a black cat on a dark road gives you a bit of a start.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黒猫|くろねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧⟦{飼|か}っていて→飼う：08151_kau⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She keeps a black cat and treats it like a member of the family.

notes:
A black-furred cat. In Japanese tradition a black cat crossing one's path is unlucky in some regions, while in others black cats are said to ward off evil and bring fortune.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒猫|くろねこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}る→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧: a black cat crosses (one's path)
- {黒猫|くろねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep a black cat

CULTURAL NOTE:
A black cat (クロネコ) is also the well-known logo of the courier company Yamato Transport, known as クロネコヤマト.
